column1: # C and C++ code that a Bazel module links into a Cadpole artifact: what no
# lockfile lists. Today that is HiGHS, in the `cadpole` CLI only (never
# the wasm engine, never the C FFI library the Apple apps link), and the
# third-party code inside HiGHS that its build compiles. Each row is one
# licence and its notice; `module` is the Bazel module it comes from, at the
# version the module graph resolves.
# What is compiled is what build_support/patches/highs_build.patch builds:
# HiGHS's own sources (MIT: highs/, including IPX and BASICLU, and the two
# extern/HighsExtras* files), the LP-file reader (MIT), pdqsort (Zlib, a
# header) and cuPDLP-C (MIT). Not in any binary: zlib and zstr (the patch drops
# the dependency; HConfig.h never defines ZLIB_FOUND), and amd (BSD-3-Clause),
# metis (Apache-2.0), rcm (MIT) and the BLAS shim, whose headers are read for
# declarations only because HIPO is undefined. A HiGHS bump re-checks this.
# Hand-maintained, like fonts.tsv; reviewed when a module that compiles C or
# C++ is added or bumped. Enforced by:
#   bazel test //build_support/licenses:license_test
# (every licence allowed; every module at the version MODULE.bazel.lock
# resolves; every repository whose C/C++ libraries a shipped artifact links
# recorded here, and nothing recorded that none links -- native_code.bzl)
